test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Answer the question based on the following letter, number and symbol series.

(left) V 2 5 @ ρ 9 W ¥ # 2 Ω RQ 1 @ FB 4 # H 6 J % Y 3 Z (right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the above series, which of the following will come at the fifth place from the right?
solution:
Given series: (left) V 2 5 @ ρ 9 W ¥ # 2 Ω RQ 1 @ FB 4 # H 6 J % Y 3 Z (right)

After removing all the numbers:

(left) V @ ρ W ¥ # Ω R Q @ F B # **H** J % Y Z (right)

Fifth place from the right end is: **H**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
